title: Lantern set-down: kneel and place
desc: The missing lantern set-down (J picked "Kneel and place"): carry by the handle, kneel, lower until the base touches, it rights itself, let go, stand; D3 also seals and lights it.

takes.name: Set down deliberate
takes.facts: kneel, lower, touchdown tick 29 (1.45 s), let go 36, stand by 64 (3.2 s); lantern rights itself over 4 ticks, ring flares on let-go

takes.name: Set down quick
takes.facts: same, faster: touchdown 19, let go 21, done 36 (1.8 s); lantern rights itself over 4 ticks, ring flares on let-go

takes.name: Set down and seal
takes.facts: touchdown 29, let go 34; ring hand rests over the lantern and it lights (pulse, then idle glow 0.12); done 76 (3.8 s); lantern rights itself over 4 ticks, ring flares on let-go

takes.name: Seal quick
takes.facts: the seal in 2.9 s: touchdown 24, let go 28, hand over it 31-41 (J: D3 IMPROVE, no note -> 3 variations)

takes.name: Seal with both hands
takes.facts: both hands rest over the lantern (43-54) while it lights (J: D3 IMPROVE, no note -> 3 variations)

takes.name: Seal and blaze
takes.facts: a longer seal (38-64), the lantern lights much brighter and the ring flares harder (J: D3 IMPROVE, no note -> 3 variations)
